points.text: The look of dark spots was reduced in 4 weeks based on an uncontrolled in-house study of 30 adults aged 25 to 55 who applied the serum twice daily alongside daytime sunscreen, assessed by trained internal evaluators comparing baseline and week-four photographs with panel-average appearance improvements, individual results varying, and effects inseparable from the sunscreen routine.
The finished serum formula contains 5% w/w niacinamide and 1% w/w tranexamic acid.
Both the 30 mL and 50 mL bottle sizes contain the identical formula concentration.
Apply two or three drops to clean, dry facial skin morning and evening, avoiding the eye area, then follow with moisturiser.
A two-bottle bundle of 30 mL bottles is available for S$68.00 from 1 October 2026 until 31 October 2026 at 23:59 Singapore time, while allocated bundle stock lasts.
Listed prices include applicable tax with free delivery of S$0.00 for Singapore orders.
Store tightly closed and away from direct sunlight.
